title: Threat Actor Mapping Foundation
goal: Map findings to relevant threat-actor or technique context without overstating attribution.
scope: Implement a first threat-context mapping slice that connects findings, methodology tags, CWEs/CVEs where present, and evidence to reviewed threat-actor or technique references. Keep output as contextual guidance, not attribution.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found threat-actor mapping was only deferred, not queued.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Provide contextual mapping only. Do not claim actor attribution, breach likelihood certainty, or unverified threat intelligence.
notes: Threat context must cite source taxonomy or curated mapping inputs.
No finding severity or canonical status should be changed by this slice.

success_criteria: Findings can display optional threat-context mappings when evidence supports them.
Mappings distinguish technique relevance from actor attribution.
Sparse findings degrade gracefully without fabricated threat context.
Tests cover mapped, unmapped, and low-confidence cases.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Threat context is optional, cited, and non-attributional.
No sparse finding receives fabricated context.
No canonical finding fields are changed.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Threat-context source taxonomy is selected and documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with threat-mapping changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the threat-context baseline and attribution limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
